mapper.insert: INSERT INTO identity_collision (workspace_id, person_identity_id, rebuilt_at) SELECT collision.workspace_id, collision.identity_id, #{rebuiltAt} FROM ( SELECT pi.workspace_id, pi.id AS identity_id, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY pi.workspace_id, pi.kind, pi.normalized_value ) AS collision_size FROM person_identity pi JOIN person p ON p.workspace_id = pi.workspace_id AND p.id = pi.person_id WHERE pi.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND pi.superseded_at IS NULL AND p.suspended_at IS NULL AND p.provision_ceased_at IS NULL ) collision WHERE collision.collision_size >= 2 ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rebuilt_at = #{rebuiltAt}

INSERT INTO identity_collision (workspace_id, company_identity_id, rebuilt_at) SELECT collision.workspace_id, collision.identity_id, #{rebuiltAt} FROM ( SELECT ci.workspace_id, ci.id AS identity_id, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY ci.workspace_id, ci.kind, ci.normalized_value ) AS collision_size FROM company_identity ci JOIN company c ON c.workspace_id = ci.workspace_id AND c.id = ci.company_id WHERE ci.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND ci.superseded_at IS NULL ) collision WHERE collision.collision_size >= 2 ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rebuilt_at = #{rebuiltAt}
